name: nexora
description: An open, censorship-resistant ledger of what gig work in India really pays, written by workers and stored on Arkiv.

scripts.test: npm run test -w nexora-ledger && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w nexora-ledger && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.api.json
